sources.name: fan_zone_campaigns
sources.purpose: Default-off testing-only fan award campaigns, approved tester audience, immutable rules/windows and free-ballot result revisions.

sources.name: fan_zone_cases
sources.purpose: Private bounded report/appeal/deletion cases with hashed reporter receipt secret/30day receipt access, actual removal completion and escalation.

sources.name: fan_zone_consents
sources.purpose: Immutable exact-entry assent/guardian permission/revocation receipts tied to scope/media revision and active confirmed supervision link.

sources.name: fan_zone_entries
sources.purpose: Private fan-video drafts/revisions, server-reserved immutable storage paths, verified media metadata, review and withdrawal state. Private guardian_consent_id pins the current exact grant; no automatic historical guardian substitution.

sources.name: fan_zone_reflections
sources.purpose: Voluntary private preset service reflection receipts, deletable by owner; no beneficiary detail or payment condition.

sources.name: filmer_rewards
sources.purpose: Filmer Aura rewards (cash column reserved, always Tapua'i-funded).

sources.name: friend_request_log
sources.purpose: Every friend request sent (PRIV-01), so the 20-a-day and 3-per-person-a-week limits cannot be reset by cancelling and asking again; admin request counts read it. No client access.

sources.name: friendships
sources.purpose: Two-way friend requests and friendships (PRIV-01); decides the "friends" audience on profiles. Written only through request_friend / respond_friend / remove_friend; a decline is kept 30 days so the requester cannot re-ask, and is never shown to them.

sources.name: game_events
sources.purpose: Per-play events the sideline scorer records.

sources.name: games
sources.purpose: Local match board: teams, scores, clock, status.

sources.name: guardian_approval_requests
sources.purpose: Under-16 requests for the guardian to approve or decline (going public, friend requests from anyone); one pending per change, 14 days. No client access; decided ones trimmed after 90 days.

sources.name: guardian_consents
sources.purpose: Signed guardian consent records (MINOR-01): form version and text hash, typed-name signature, relationship, permissions (public profile, payouts), revocation. Append-only; kept after account deletion for the period counsel sets (LEGAL row AA). No client access.

sources.name: guardian_invite_attempts
sources.purpose: Wrong guardian-code tries, so 8-character codes cannot be guessed (10 a day per account). No client access; trimmed after 2 days.

sources.name: guardian_invites
sources.purpose: Hashed one-time guardian codes a teen shares (48 hours, newest only, 5 a day). No client access; trimmed after 30 days by the desk's retention purge.

sources.name: guardian_links
sources.purpose: A teen's linked parent or guardian (MINOR-01): from the teen's invite code (counts once the teen confirms) or the admin-set guardian on record; at most two; either side ends it, and a block ends it. Supervision only, never control. No client access.

sources.name: ledger_accounts
sources.purpose: Chart of accounts for the books.

sources.name: ledger_manual_entries
sources.purpose: Hand-recorded journal entries (expenses, Stripe fees, refunds, payouts).

sources.name: ledger_manual_lines
sources.purpose: Debit and credit lines of recorded entries.

sources.name: operator_checkins
sources.purpose: GPS check-ins of game-day operators.

sources.name: operator_gigs

sources.name: payee_verifications
sources.purpose: Append-only record of how each payee was verified (VERIFY-02): Stripe identity and tax ID result, the school's parent-on-record confirmation, document reviews (document not kept), Stripe Identity for disputes; status, reviewer, reason. Never an SSN. No client access.

sources.name: payout_flag_overrides
sources.purpose: Two-admin requests to turn a payee's transfers on or off by hand (VERIFY-02): reason, requester, second-admin decision, 7-day expiry. No client access.
